fusions.name: Rust in the Joints
fusions.desc: Flicks water into the joints of a target's armour, dealing 7 damage with a 50% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Moulted Plates
fusions.desc: Sheds 3 steel plates from among your feathers in a spread, each dealing 12 damage and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Riveted Down
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and raises your armour by 10%, both for 8 seconds. You move 12% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Layered Against Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once into a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour is 5% higher at all times.
